_doc: Evaluation set v2. Each question has evidence_sets: a chunk is relevant to a set if it comes from one of the set's gold pages ([report code, page, grade]) and contains one of its evidence strings. Grade 2 = the quarter's own report, grade 1 = a later report repeating the same figure. Multi-period questions have one set per period; unanswerable questions have none and should be declined. answer_facts: an answer is correct if it contains one alternative from every group (numbers matched whole). Chart answers were checked against the rendered page images.
